description: We are a team of curious minds drawn to the quiet, forgotten corners of the cosmos. We believe that the hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars isn't just "space junk"—it’s a collection of silent monuments carrying stories of human ambition. We are here to uncover those hidden tales and bring them back to life in a way no one expects.
summary:
The Forgotten Heroes is an interactive storybook website about NASA’s abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. Akaay, a boy who loves space, falls asleep and meets a guide named Atlas. Together they visit the rovers Spirit and Opportunity, the Viking landers and the Apollo Lunar Module, along with Hubble, Voyager and Pioneer.

The site is designed like a real book, with a cover, contents page and back cover. Each chapter has a short story, an illustration, our own narration and a pop-up video of real space footage. A puzzle quiz at the end checks what readers learned.

These machines did historic work and were left behind. Telling their stories as a friendly dream adventure makes the science simple and fun, and turns “discarded” equipment into remembered heroes. Built with React and Vite.
details:
• JavaScript (React) and CSS, with a small amount of HTML (about 73%, 27% and under 1% of the code)
  • Vite for development and building, React Router for navigation, Lucide icons, and GSAP for animation
  • VS Code, Git and GitHub for teamwork
  • Our own voice recordings, hand-drawn illustrations and video clips stored in the project
  • AI assistants (Claude and VS Code coding assistants) helped us plan, prototype and write parts of the code. We reviewed and tested the results ourselves.
  • Hardware: laptops, and Chrome for testing
